cz.st: No matter ___ you ask, the answer will be the same.

patches.why: 'whether' distractor can form a grammatical sentence.

bad: Whether we wins or lose, we will have fun.
Whether win we or lose, we will have fun.
Whether we win or lose, we will having fun.
set.rule: whether A or B에서 or는 짝이 되는 말이에요. 양보의 whether절은 'Whether we win or lose'처럼 현재시제로 쓰는 것이 자연스럽고, 주어 we에는 win을 써요. 주절의 will 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요.

patches.why: 'Whether we will win or lose' is grammatical; replace with a clear error and soften rule.

bad: We can meet whenever it are convenient for you.
We can meet whenever it convenient for you.
We can meet whenever of it is convenient for you.

patches.why: 'whenever is convenient' is attested; replace with a clearly wrong form.

cz.st: Wherever there ___ water, plants can grow.

patches.why: 'there be' is a literary subjunctive; avoid.

set.q:
빈칸에 알맞은 말은?
___ his poor health, my grandfather walks to the park every morning.
set.why: 빈칸 뒤에 명사구(his poor health)만 있으므로 전치사 despite가 알맞아요. 나머지는 절을 이끄는 접속사예요.

patches.why: Determiner fix; changes identity field q.
